# netactuate_bgp_groups (Data Source)

Reads BGP Groups visible to the account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_bgp_groups" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `group_type` (String) BGP group type filter. The API defaults this to anycast when omitted.

### Read-Only

- `groups` (List of Object) BGP groups visible to the account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--groups))
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--groups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `groups`

Read-Only:

- `bgp_group_id` (Number)
- `description` (String)
- `group_type` (String)
- `name` (String)
